description:
Get what an order costs, as the order will charge it. mode 'create' (default): a new token on each chain, its registration included. mode 'claim': registering a token that already exists on each chain (free for an OG token when symbol and address are given). All params optional. Two or more chains take the 10% multi-chain bundle discount, already subtracted from total_usd.

Params: chains (string[]?), mode ('create'|'claim'?), symbol (string?), address (string?), bundle_type (string?), wallet_address (string?)
Returns: {items: [{chain, type, fee_usd, gas_estimate}], discounts: [{type, description, amount_usd}], total_usd: number}
Errors: API_ERROR

address.description: With mode 'claim': the token's contract or mint address, so an OG token shows as free

bundle_type.description: Label for the bundle discount line only; the discount itself follows the number of chains

mode.description: 'create' (default) prices a new token; 'claim' prices registering a token that already exists

wallet_address.description: Accepted for compatibility; pricing does not depend on the wallet

name: get_pricing
title: Get pricing
